title: Unit – 5 : Session – 9 : SLO – 2  |  Designing Simple Interactive Forms Using Events
sections: 1. Aligning widgets vertically — pack them with side="top" (the default): widget.pack(), or use grid() placing each widget in its own row.
2. Reading user input from an Entry — call entry.get(), typically inside the submit button's handler: name = entry_name.get().

3. What makes a form "interactive" — widgets are bound to event handlers (button commands, key bindings, validation callbacks) so the application reacts immediately to user actions: submitting, validating, enabling/disabling fields and updating output dynamically.
